title: Abar Proloy
overview: Crime Branch officer Animesh Datta is on a mission to catch the mastermind of a girl child trafficking racket in the Sunderbans. Will he be able to track down the culprit before more young girls disappear?

title: Dakghor
overview: Damodar Das comes to the remote village of Hagda as its new postmaster. While their simple aspirations and pure emotions slowly do away with Damodar's reservations, he keeps searching for a sliver of his long-lost childhood.

title: Feluda Pherot
overview: Jawto Kando Kathmandute is a Feluda mystery where the detective travels to Kathmandu with Topse and Jatayu to investigate a murder and a fake medicine racket, ultimately confronting Maganlal Meghraj, a familiar antagonist.

title: Indu
overview: Huge mansions have heinous secrets. As clandestine family ties, scandals and uncanny deaths spiral around the dark hallways of Indu's home, she leaves no stone unturned to untangle the mystery.
